'''Red Line''' was a [[Band/Legends|band]] from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], whose career ended before the start of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
This band raised controversial issues before the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Their songs contained usual instances of verbal violence against the highest political circles, as the band considered themselves to be the voice of the marginalized.

Red Line was founded by [[Soltan Wostikian]], a young socialite from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world of [[Hashaulh]]. The famous [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Poet/Legends|poetess]] [[Hari Seldona]] sometimes wrote for the band.

==Behind the scenes==
The band Red Line was created by [[Philippe Rat]] for the ambiguously [[canon]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] scenario "[[Prélude à un nouvel espoir]]" which appeared in the French magazine ''[[Casus Belli 103]]''.
